steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Setup core folders and project environment configs for Brain Blitz with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5 compatibility.

steps.title: Configure App Permissions & Manifest
steps.description: Define standard manifest with strict XML namespace validation and single-activity navigation setup.

steps.title: Set Java Compatibility level
steps.description: Establish proper source and target Java compatibility configurations in compileOptions.

steps.title: Design Unified User Interface Layout
steps.description: Build dynamic UI layout with modular sections for Memory Grid, Math Sprint, and Stroop Test panels.

steps.title: Implement Programmatic Sound Module
steps.description: Establish zero-latency programmatic sound effects generator utilizing Android native ToneGenerator API.

steps.title: Incorporate SharedPreferences System
steps.description: Code local key-value store database to persist high-scores for each respective brain-game mode.

steps.title: Design Memory Matrix Challenge Logic
steps.description: Program matrix grid system that dynamically scales tile dimensions, handles pattern flashes, and tracks player precision.

steps.title: Code Math Sprint Rapid Engine
steps.description: Incorporate fast mental arithmetic simulator containing automated logic for true/false validation on randomized terms.

steps.title: Incorporate Stroop Color Test Logic
steps.description: Develop cognitive mismatch evaluator system using custom font coloring templates and interactive prompt validations.

steps.title: Optimize Graphic Styling Engine
steps.description: Write high-performance programmatically loaded GradientDrawable elements supporting seamless rounded cards, borders, and modern colors.

steps.title: Code Game-Over Summary Dashboard
steps.description: Formulate intuitive game over cards to summarize current performance levels, high scores, rewards, and play-again triggers.

steps.title: Conduct Memory Leak Mitigation Tests
steps.description: Configure strict programmatic cleanups of active handlers and countdown loops to avoid background CPU drains.

steps.title: Perform Java 8 Backward-Compatibility Checks
steps.description: Verify standard legacy inner classes implementation formats to guarantee error-free compilation parameters.

steps.title: Finalize Package Namespace Verification
steps.description: Ensure absolute coherence between AndroidManifest, Gradle modules, and the main Java source package imports.

steps.title: Building Brain Blitz
steps.description: Compile, bundle, and optimize the final debug application target ready for deployment.
